lines.en: I carry my crossbow along the road.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩在土上，很响。
lines.en: My boots ring on the dirt.

lines.zh: 腰间的烟花筒一碰就响。
lines.en: The firework tubes at my belt click as I move.
I push through a stand of low trees.

lines.zh: 我绕到路边的石头后面。
lines.en: I move behind a stone by the road.
I am looking for high ground.
A rise ahead. Perfect.
I climb it and slow my pace.
My tracks drag all the way to the village gate.
No pursuit.
I keep to the road.
My crossbow shifts on my shoulder.
I stand on the rise and look down.
I can see both ends of the road.

lines.zh: 我把一支烟花装进槽里。
lines.en: I load a rocket into the groove.
A click. It seats.
I check the tubes I have left.
Plenty.
Wind crosses the rise and moves the grass.
I do not move.
I wait for someone to appear on the road.
There is always someone on this road.
The wind comes again.
I rest the crossbow on my shoulder.
And keep waiting.
The crossbow stays in my hands.
I do not set it down.
Not these days.

lines.zh: 我这把弩里，装的是烟花。
lines.en: My crossbow is loaded with fireworks.
I look that way.
I am on the rise; you are on the road.

lines.zh: 我腰间的烟花筒一碰就响。
lines.en: The firework rack at my belt rattles.
I raise the crossbow.
You look up, I pull the trigger.
The firework is already lit.
I aim at the ground before your feet.
This shot is a warning.
You come to a stop.
Settled.
I lower the muzzle.
The next will not stray.
You have withdrawn.

lines.zh: 六十四发烟花，我全带着。
lines.en: Sixty-four rockets, all mine.
I raise the crossbow at it.
My hands shake a little.
I steady my hands.
The muzzle is still level.
I grit my teeth.
A firework burst on my crossbow.
I will return it.
One shot will do.
I am counting how many steps it needs.
Fireworks do not trade for food.
You raise that thing high.
My muzzle stays on you.
Set it down, then walk ten paces off.
I look, and do not come down.
I do not leave high ground for food.
Put it back.
It might buy something.
But not today.
I am not looking. Pack it up quickly.
You hit me and I do not give ground.
I bring the crossbow across to block.
The wood is hard.
You stepped back twice; my crossbow stays level.
I do not run people down.
I raise the muzzle.
I level the crossbow.
That is right.
I hold the crossbow across my body.
I follow this road down.
Pillagers do not speak of this.
We speak of loot.

lines.zh: 谁能抢到手，谁就是好的。
lines.en: Whoever takes it is the better.
I carry a crossbow. That is enough.
At night we sit around a fire.
Each counts his own.
None looks at another.
At dawn we part.
One clap and we scatter.
I stand and go.

lines.zh: 翻过来看看，还能不能用。
lines.en: Turn it over, see if it still works.

lines.zh: 我的弩里，装着六十四发烟花。
lines.en: My crossbow holds sixty-four rockets.
I toss it aside.
This fuse is not burnt through yet.
My ammo pouch got a little heavier.
The bag is already full.
I press it down.
There is room for a little more.
I keep searching.
A few more.
Someone on the road.
I level the crossbow.
The wind is light. It will matter a little.
I allow for it.
The rocket is in the groove.
My finger finds the trigger.
The road is straight. Easy to aim.
There is a stone there.
Wait until he reaches the stone.
Loose.
I keep him in my sights.

lines.zh: 他往左，我就把弩移过去。
lines.en: He goes left; I follow with the muzzle.
He hides behind a tree.
The tree hides his body.
I aim beside the trunk.
I hold my breath.
I do not stir at all.
The rocket is light.
I wait for him to come out.

lines.zh: 他不动，我也不动，烟花已经上弦。
lines.en: He does not move and neither do I; the fireworks are loaded.
I put one at his feet.
The dirt bursts.
He leaps and stumbles back.
I load the second at once.
A click.
This one lands ahead of him.
A crater opens in the road.
He stops short.
I raise the crossbow.
I do not load a third.
I wake at the roadside.
The crossbow is still in my hands.
The rockets too.
I sit up and look around.
This road is good for an ambush.
Stones on both sides.

lines.zh: 烟花火箭，已经装了六十四发。
lines.en: Sixty-four firework rockets loaded.
And brush off the dirt.
I walk up the rise.
From there I can see a long way.
I set the crossbow ready.
Then crouch.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的外套，我在地上滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat and I roll once on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下去，弩脱了手。
lines.en: I fall from the rise and the crossbow leaves my hands.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我抱着弩往上挣。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I cling to the crossbow and struggle up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，腰间的筒子全散了。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and my tubes scatter.

lines.zh: 六十四发烟花，全在弩上。
lines.en: Sixty-four rockets, all loaded in this crossbow.

lines.zh: 怪光罩住我，我抬不起弩。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me and I cannot lift the crossbow.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，瞄准都在晃。
lines.en: Two days without food and my aim wavers.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我手里的弩哑了。
lines.en: At the thunderclap my crossbow went silent.

lines.zh: 路没了，我在黑里往下掉。
lines.en: The road is gone and I fall through black.
